card.name: Inside brand names ending in -JA/-JO
card.fires_on: The piece just before a final 'J' in brand drug names such as INBRIJA, TRADJENTA, VONJO, VIJOICE and BLUJEPA. It fires when the next piece is expected to start with J.

modes.label: INBRIJA
modes.description: The RI piece in INBRIJA, right before JA.

modes.label: VONJO / VIJOICE
modes.description: The ON in VONJO or the VI in VIJOICE, right before J.

modes.label: TRADJENTA / BLUJEPA
modes.description: The AD in TRADJENTA or the U in BLUJEPA, right before J.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict a next piece that starts with J, such as 'ju', 'jet' or 'jo'.
card.plain: It fires inside a brand name when the next letters should be a J, as in INBRIJA or VONJO.
